description: Install and manage game mods (UE4SS and Nightmare Save Unlocker)

gamePath.title: Game Path
gamePath.notSet: Game root folder not set yet
gamePath.valid: Recognized as the Escape The Backrooms game directory
gamePath.invalidNotGameRoot: No valid game structure found (EscapeTheBackrooms/Binaries/Win64 is required)

ue4ss.author: by EscapeTheBackroomsCommunity
ue4ss.desc: UE4SS is a Lua scripting injection framework for Unreal Engine — the required foundation for running UE mods. The recommended version is community-verified; the latest build carries the newest fixes and features.
ue4ss.uninstallMessage: All third-party mods that depend on UE4SS will be removed first, then UE4SS itself. This cannot be undone.
ue4ss.uninstallNoDependents: No third-party mods depending on UE4SS were detected.
ue4ss.uninstallDependentsPrefix: These third-party mods will also be removed:

nsu.name: Nightmare Save Unlocker
nsu.author: by Eververdants
nsu.desc: Unlocks Nightmare-difficulty save features. Registers itself under ue4ss/Mods and is enabled automatically after install; toggle it on or off anytime.
nsu.enableDesc: Enable or disable this mod (edits mods.txt)
nsu.requiresUe4ss: Requires UE4SS to be installed first
nsu.uninstallMessage: The mod will be removed from ue4ss/Mods and its mods.txt entry cleaned up. UE4SS itself is left untouched.

toast.ue4ssUninstalledWithDeps: UE4SS and its dependent mods ({mods}) were uninstalled

errors.nsuNotInstalled: Nightmare Save Unlocker is not installed
